decisions.reviewNotes: The provider-owned page identifies Dr Tanya Saul, publishes the existing practice contact details, and explicitly requires the user's GP to submit a referral through Specialist Referrals. A second independent fetch reproduced the wording, and a community-maintained directory corroborates the referral requirement. The directory reports a two-to-three-month wait but asks users to verify details with the clinic, while the provider-owned page does not publish a current wait, so availability remains not_published and review-required. No specialty, telehealth, age-group, cultural, or verification claim is added.
